title: The Incorrigible Crybaby
party_selection_rule: 5 vs 5 Party Selection (select your 5 designated Pokémon from your active party when prompted at battle start)
overview: Whitney commands Normal-type fusions combining massive defensive bulks, status disruption, and momentum-building setup moves. Lickitung/Granbull leads with Play Rough and Charm to cripple physical sweepers. Girafarig/Lanturn sets up Aqua Ring while using Power Swap to trade stat modifications. Dunsparce/Kangaskhan boosts with Coil and strikes with Dizzy Punch confusion. Aipom/Tauros hits with fast Take Down and resets damage with Rest and Lum Berry. Her ace, Chansey/Miltank, is an astonishing defensive titan: holding an Eviolite to boost its 1.5x defenses, it shrugs off special attacks, sustains with Milk Drink, and ramps up lethal momentum with Rollout.

roster.tactics: Lead physical debuffer. Fires Fairy STAB Play Rough and drops incoming physical Attack with Charm. Hit hard with Poison or Steel special attacks before Attack debuffs stack.
Electric/Normal hybrid. Sets Aqua Ring for passive recovery and uses Power Swap to steal offensive buffs. Exploit Ground-type moves like Earthquake for an easy super-effective KO.
Coil booster. Coil increases Attack, Defense, and Accuracy simultaneously. Dizzy Punch inflicts confusion. Fighting moves like Close Combat cleanly punch through its bulk before Coil stacks.
Work Up physical breaker. Boosts offenses, hits hard with Take Down recoil, and cures status with Lum Berry after Rest. Hit with super-effective Fighting STAB to drop it rapidly.

Whitney's signature nightmare Ace. Eviolite boosts its physical and special Defenses by 1.5x on top of massive Chansey HP. Scrappy allows it to hit Ghost types. Milk Drink restores 50% HP. Never let Rollout gain consecutive turns; reset its momentum immediately with Protect, Steel resistance, or devastating Fighting STAB like Close Combat.

starter_strategies.bulbasaur: Venusaur/Charizard resists Fairy Play Rough and puts Chansey/Miltank to sleep with Sleep Powder. Kingler/Primeape breaks Eviolite defenses with STAB Close Combat and Crabhammer. Alakazam/Weezing and Gyarados/Arbok pivot on physical strikes with Intimidate and recover freely.
starter_strategies.charmander: Charizard/Venusaur provides Ground immunity against Dig and melts Whitney's team with Flamethrower. Primeape/Sandslash is the primary wallbreaker, cleanly smashing Dunsparce/Kangaskhan and Chansey/Miltank with Close Combat. Snorlax mirrors Whitney's bulk and sponges Rollout.
starter_strategies.squirtle: Blastoise/Fearow evades Dig and tanks Normal hits with high Defense. Arbok/Primeape provides Intimidate support and shreds Chansey/Miltank with Close Combat. Jolteon/Sandslash sets up Swords Dance and wipes Girafarig/Lanturn with Earthquake.
